title: 🧹 [Code Health] Remove redundant cleanIp variable assignment in API routes
body:
## 🧹 Code Health Improvement Task

### 🎯 What
Removed redundant `const cleanIp = ip;` assignments in `app/api/explain/route.ts` and `app/api/check/route.ts`, updating references to use `ip` directly.

### 💡 Why
This improves readability and removes unnecessary intermediate variables. It's a follow-up cleanup to the previous IP extraction refactor.

### ✅ Verification
Verified by ensuring `npm run test` passes successfully, completing pre-commit steps and avoiding behavioral changes.

### ✨ Result
Cleaner, more readable API routes.
